# Logitech® Easy-Switch setup: Control devices across PCs

Using a single keyboard or mouse with multiple devices can help increase productivity, but it’s not always a straightforward process. To pair a mouse or keyboard to a separate device, you typically need to unpair it from your computer and connect it to the new device.

Logitech® Easy-Switch offers a straightforward solution for pairing your mouse or keyboard with multiple devices, enabling you to switch between devices with the press of a button. With Easy-Switch, you can pair your mouse or keyboard to up to three devices. [...] If you want to use your Logitech mouse or keyboard with multiple devices, Easy-Switch is the answer. Follow this Logitech Easy-Switch setup guide to get started and discover how to switch devices with a Logitech keyboard.

Logitech® Easy-Switch setup: Control devices across PCs

## What is Logitech Easy-Switch?

Logitech Easy-Switch is proprietary technology from Logitech that allows you to quickly switch between multiple devices. You can connect your Logitech Easy-Switch keyboard and mouse to your desktop computer, laptop, and tablet, and use the Easy-Switch buttons to quickly switch from one device to the next. Easy-Switch enables you to connect to up to three devices using a single mouse or keyboard.
